description: CMR 2018 - Retail Fixed Internet Sector and Broadband Availability is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Canadian Radio-television and Telecommunications Commission | Conseil de la radiodiffusion et des télécommunications canadiennes. The Canadian Radio-television and Telecommunications Commission (hereafter, the Commission) annually collects financial and subscription information on Internet services. In addition, information on the availability of broadband Internet services is collected in partnership with Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada (ISED). Coverage: Canada. The portal files it under the publisher Canadian Radio-television and Telecommunications Commission | Conseil de la radiodiffusion et des télécommunications canadiennes. Its tags are Télécommunications, Large bande, Internet, CRTC, Statistiques. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, DOCX, XLSX. The portal shows 2018-12-20 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
